name: Rise Kujikawa as Announcer
creator: shoutfriends
description:
> "Ladies and gentlemen! Here we go! I, Risette, will be your commentator!"

This mod replaces default Summoner's Rift announcer with Rise Kujikawa from Persona 4.

Listen to Rise Kujikawa cheer you and your team while you play the game! Voicelines taken from Persona 4 Golden and Persona 4 Arena Ultimax (Laura Bailey only!).

[List of voiceline changes](https://pastebin.com/WWER00rA "List of voiceline changes")
